notes: Wear long sleeves, long pants and shoes that can get muddy. Work is canceled in freezing weather or pouring rain. Good for community service ideas, but ask about age rules first.
name: Volunteer Natural Area Work Days
org: City of East Lansing Parks, Recreation and Arts
what_you_do: Pull invasive plants like garlic mustard and buckthorn from city parks. The city gives you gloves, tools and refreshments.
who_can_apply: Community members. The page does not state an age rule, so ask before you go if you are under 18.
deadline_text: Next work days: Nov 14 and Dec 12, 2026, then Jan 9, Feb 13, Mar 13 and Apr 10, 2027. Through March they remove buckthorn at Albert A. White Park. The Apr 10 site is not set.
how_to_apply: Contact the Art and Stewardship Coordinator, Heather Majano. Call (517) 319-6804 or email hmajano@cityofeastlansing.com. You can also email the Stewardship Intern, Felix Shalev, at fshalev@cityofeastlansing.com.
